title: "Web SDK reference"
description: "Options, methods, state, and callbacks."

## createCapture(options)

Initializes the SDK and loads the scan’s state. Returns a promise for the capture instance. Camera access begins with `start()`.

<ParamField body="video" type="HTMLVideoElement" required>
Mounted preview element.
</ParamField>
<ParamField body="token" type="string" required>
Capture token returned by the API.
</ParamField>
<ParamField body="configuration" type="string" required>
Configuration returned with the capture token. Pass unchanged.
</ParamField>
<ParamField body="onState" type="(state: CaptureState) => void" required>
Receives lifecycle, selection, guidance, and error updates.
</ParamField>

### Callbacks

| Option | Signature | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onCaptureComplete` | `(scanId: string) => void` | All required captures accepted. |
| `onComplete` | `(scanId: string) => void` | Processing finished. |
| `onTorchChange` | `(state: TorchState) => void` | Flashlight availability or enabled state changed. |
| `onJobStatus` | `(status: SubscribeJobStatusResponse) => void` | Processing job updated. |

## Methods

| Method | Returns | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update({ country?, documentType? })` | `void` | Changes the selection before any capture is accepted. Country uses an ISO alpha-2 code; document type uses `DocumentType`. |
| `start()` | `void` | Starts the camera from `READY`, or resumes a stopped capture. |
| `capture()` | `void` | Requests manual capture during `CAPTURING_FRONT` or `CAPTURING_REAR`. |
| `stop()` | `void` | Stops capture and releases the camera. |
| `destroy()` | `void` | Releases the instance and its resources. |
| `setTorch(enabled: boolean)` | `Promise<void>` | Sets the flashlight; rejects when unavailable. |

## CaptureState

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phase` | `Phase` | Capture lifecycle state. |
| `guidance` | `Guidance` | Capture feedback. |
| `country` | `string` | Selected ISO alpha-2 country; empty before selection. |
| `allowedDocumentTypes` | `DocumentType[]` | Available types for the selected country. |
| `documentType` | `DocumentType` | Selected type. |
| `reading` | `Reading` | What still needs decoding on the current side: `BARCODE_2D`, `MRZ`, or `UNSPECIFIED` once a reading was accepted. |
| `error` | `{ code: ErrorCode; status: number }?` | Capture failure. |


### Phase

| Value | State |
| --- | --- |
| `UNSPECIFIED` | No lifecycle state assigned. |
| `AUTHORIZING` | Initializing the scan. |
| `SELECTING_COUNTRY` | Awaiting country selection. |
| `SELECTING_DOCUMENT` | Awaiting document selection. |
| `UPDATING` | Saving selection. |
| `READY` | Ready for `start()`. |
| `CAPTURING_FRONT` | Camera capture active for the front. |
| `CAPTURING_REAR` | Camera capture active for the rear. |
| `SUBMITTING` | Submitting captured evidence. |
| `PROCESSING` | Server processing in progress. |
| `COMPLETE` | Processing finished. |
| `FAILED` | Failed; see `error.code`. |
| `SUPERSEDED` | Another instance took over the scan. |
| `STOPPED` | Capture stopped. |

### Guidance

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `UNSPECIFIED` | No guidance available. |
| `ALIGN_DOCUMENT` | Document alignment or framing is insufficient. |
| `HOLD_STILL` | Document is readable; capture is stabilizing. |
| `FLIP_DOCUMENT` | The visible side has already been captured. |
| `REDUCE_GLARE` | Glare obscures the document. |
| `MOVE_CLOSER` | Document details are not readable at the current distance. |
| `IMPROVE_FOCUS` | The image is insufficiently sharp. |
| `CLEAR_BACKGROUND` | Document detection remains uncertain. |
| `READING_DOCUMENT` | A manually captured image is being analyzed. |

### Side

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `UNSPECIFIED` | No capture side requested. |
| `FRONT` | Photo side or document photo page. |
| `REAR` | Reverse side. |

### DocumentType

| Value | Document |
| --- | --- |
| `UNSPECIFIED` | No document type selected. |
| `UNKNOWN` | Unclassified document. |
| `DRIVERS_LICENSE` | Driver’s license. |
| `ENHANCED_DRIVERS_LICENSE` | Enhanced driver’s license. |
| `STATE_ID` | State ID. |
| `PASSPORT_BOOK` | Passport. |
| `PASSPORT_CARD` | Passport card. |
| `PERMANENT_RESIDENT_CARD` | Permanent resident card. |
| `EMPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_CARD` | Employment authorization card. |
| `GLOBAL_ENTRY_CARD` | Global Entry card. |
| `MILITARY_ID` | Military ID. |
| `VISA` | Visa. |
| `OTHER_TRAVEL_DOCUMENT` | Other travel document. |
| `MOBILE_DOCUMENT` | Mobile document. |

Available selections are returned in `allowedDocumentTypes`.

### ErrorCode

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `UNSPECIFIED` | No error code assigned. |
| `ABORTED` | Operation canceled. |
| `CALLBACK_FAILED` | An application callback failed. |
| `CAMERA_PERMISSION_DENIED` | Camera permission was denied. |
| `CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE` | The camera or a camera frame is unavailable. |
| `CAPTURE_FAILED` | Capture could not complete. |
| `COUNTRY_MISMATCH` | Document issuer differs from the selected country. |
| `DOCUMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH` | Document differs from the selected type. |
| `IMAGE_ENCODING_FAILED` | The captured image could not be encoded. |
| `INVALID_AUTHORIZATION` | Initialization credentials or configuration are invalid. |
| `INVALID_CAPTURE_SNAPSHOT` | Capture state is invalid or inconsistent. |
| `INVALID_EVIDENCE` | The server rejected the submitted evidence. |
| `INVALID_JOB_STATUS` | A processing status update is invalid. |
| `INVALID_REQUEST` | Request or operation arguments are invalid. |
| `INVALID_RESPONSE` | A response is invalid. |
| `KEY_GENERATION_FAILED` | Capture key generation failed. |
| `NETWORK_ERROR` | A network request failed. |
| `SIGNING_FAILED` | Capture signing failed. |
| `SUPERSEDED` | See `Phase.SUPERSEDED`. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | Credentials were rejected. |

## TorchState

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `available` | `boolean` |
| `enabled` | `boolean` |

See [Errors](/external/recovery) for error handling and [Results](/external/results) for verification decisions.
